page.overview:
Who is Doraise Mesianos?

Doraise Mesianos is an Aes Sedai of the Brown Ajah.

Although unconfirmed, her melodious surname ending in -os suggests an Illianer origin.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the split.

Alviarin Freidhen suggests that Elaida a'Roihan reward her, along with Farellien and Kiyoshi, while simultaneously punishing Josaine and Adelorna Bastine, who held angreal and ter'angreal without the Tower's permission or knowledge. This would imply that one of the three had informed on those that were punished, thereby creating strife among the Ajahs.
